## What each type does - SP (soft point): standard damage for its caliber, with slightly worse armor penetration at -13%; moderate penetration and ricochet chances. - HP (hollow point): usually around +30% damage, no armor penetration, and -70…100% effectiveness against armor; low penetration and ricochet chances. - FMJ (full metal jacket): usually -30…-40% damage, but around 25% armor penetration; high penetration and ricochet chances. - AP (armor-piercing): maximum armor penetration (around 69%) with reduced damage; the best choice against armor. - Rubber: low damage and high stamina damage; non-lethal. - Practice: minimal damage; training ammunition. - Incendiary: deals part of its damage as heat and can ignite the target. - Uranium: adds radiation damage and has better penetration and ricochet performance. - Buckshot: multiple pellets, best damage at point-blank range, and rapidly loses effectiveness over distance. - Slug: one heavy projectile with better range and armor penetration, but no area damage. - Less-lethal: non-lethal damage and severe stamina damage or stunning. - Flare: light and ignition with low direct damage. - Tranquilizer: a chemical effect (sedation) with minimal direct damage. - Improvised (glass): homemade ammunition with wide spread and low accuracy; best at close range. - Improvised incendiary: homemade ammunition that ignites targets. - Improvised uranium: homemade ammunition with radiation damage. - Improvised (coin shot): a heavy improvised projectile with a strong close-range impact but poor range. - Alcohol: a chemical payload that applies reagent effects. - Holy: special effects and holy damage, useful against certain targets. - 15 mm anti-materiel: enormous structural damage and stopping power; cannot penetrate targets or structures without destroying them completely. - 15 mm armor-piercing: maximum armor penetration and the chance to penetrate targets or structures. - 15 mm fragmentation: a small explosion and area shrapnel damage. - 15 mm explosive: explosive area and structural damage. - 15 mm EMP: causes an EMP, disables electronics, and damages mechs and cyborgs. - Artillery: travels vastly farther than other ammunition at the cost of performance. It is usually used in shuttle weaponry.
